name: Inugami-sama to Mujintou Shugyou♪Mezase Gekokujou! ~Nuite wa Naran! Onushi no Chitsudashi de Washi o Ikasetemisei!~
original_name: 犬神さまと無人島修行♪目指せ下剋上！～抜いてはならん！おぬしの膣出しで儂をイカせてみせい！～
source:
Kazuma was born into a long line of martial artists. Growing up, he was subjected to a strict training regimen by his father to prepare him to take over the family dojo. Kazuma, who wants nothing more than to live his life on his own terms, tries to escape his father’s hellish training in order to enjoy his final summer holiday as a college student but is quickly caught and then shipped off to a deserted island! Waking up with the barest camping supplies and a note from his father stating he cannot come home until he defeats ‘the demon of Inugami Island.’

With his summer plans effectively ruined, Kazuma searches for shelter and almost immediately runs into the big boss, the Inugami dog spirit herself! Kazuma, rather clumsily, explains his situation in a last-ditch effort to escape the wrath of the creature who not only understands his ‘human speak’ but shapeshifts into a fluffy-tailed maiden and the two come to a surprising agreement. In exchange for learning some secret [i]doggy-style[/i] techniques from Tomoe to get his father off his case, Kazuma will provide her with his ‘youthful essence~’

Watch as Tomoe and Kazuma evolve from master and student into [i]something more[/i] over the course of their training on Inugami Island.

[Edited from [url=https://cherrykissgames.com/portfolio/inugami-doggy-dojo]Cherry Kiss Games[/url]]
translation:
一真出生于传承悠久的武术世家。为了让他将来继承家中道场，父亲从小便要求他接受严格训练。一真只想按照自己的意愿生活；大学最后一个暑假来临时，他试图逃离父亲地狱般的训练，却很快被抓住，随后直接送到一座无人岛上！醒来时，他身边只有最基本的露营用品，以及父亲留下的字条：在击败“犬神岛之鬼”以前，不准回家。

暑假计划彻底泡汤，一真只好寻找住处，却几乎立刻撞见了这里真正的首领——犬神本尊！为了躲过对方的怒火，一真笨拙地解释自己的处境。犬神不仅听得懂他的“人话”，还能化身为长着毛茸茸尾巴的少女，二人最终意外达成协议：巴会传授一真某些秘密的[i]犬式[/i]技巧，帮他应付父亲；作为交换，一真则要献上自己的“青春精华～”。

在犬神岛的修行过程中，巴与一真的关系将从师徒逐渐变成[i]更加亲密的存在[/i]。

[编辑自[url=https://cherrykissgames.com/portfolio/inugami-doggy-dojo]Cherry Kiss Games[/url]]
